description: Flat record-level metadata schema for 18S rRNA amplicon sequencing data from airborne microbial communities collected in urban environments, including site context, sampling conditions, air quality covariates, and sequencing/processing details.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual air-sample record. Must be stable and unique within the dataset (e.g., 'AIR_001').

study_id.descr: Identifier for the parent study or project to which this sample belongs.

city.descr: City where the air sample was collected.

country.descr: Country where the air sample was collected.

site_name.descr: Specific sampling site name or code (e.g., park name, street intersection, building rooftop).

site_environment.descr: Urban site category; expected values may include 'industrial', 'park', 'residential', 'commercial', 'roadside', or 'mixed'.

sampling_latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

sampling_longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

sampling_elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling location above sea level, in meters.

sample_date.descr: Date when the sample was collected, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sample_local_time.descr: Local start time of sampling, in 24-hour format if available (HH:MM:SS).

season.descr: Season of collection; expected values may include 'spring', 'summer', 'autumn', 'winter', or 'wet/dry' depending on study region.

sampling_duration_min.descr: Total air collection duration, in minutes.

air_volume_m3.descr: Total volume of air sampled, in cubic meters (m^3).

sampler_type.descr: Air sampler instrument type or model used to collect airborne particulates/bioaerosols.

sampler_flow_rate_l_min.descr: Average sampler flow rate, in liters per minute (L/min).

inlet_height_m.descr: Height of the sampler inlet above ground level, in meters.

filter_material.descr: Filter or collection medium material used for sampling (e.g., PTFE, quartz, nylon).

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size, in micrometers (µm), if applicable.

field_blank_included.descr: Indicates whether a field blank was collected alongside the sample.

technical_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for a technical replicate, if the sample was sequenced more than once.

biological_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for a biological replicate or repeated independent collection from the same site/time context.

pm2_5_ug_m3.descr: Particulate matter concentration for particles with aerodynamic diameter <= 2.5 µm, in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m^3).

pm10_ug_m3.descr: Particulate matter concentration for particles with aerodynamic diameter <= 10 µm, in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m^3).

relative_humidity_percent.descr: Ambient relative humidity at time of sampling, in percent (%).

air_temperature_c.descr: Ambient air temperature at time of sampling, in degrees Celsius (°C).

wind_speed_m_s.descr: Wind speed at sampling time, in meters per second (m/s).

wind_direction_deg.descr: Wind direction at sampling time, in degrees clockwise from north (0-360).

precipitation_mm.descr: Precipitation during or immediately preceding sampling, in millimeters (mm).

air_quality_index.descr: Local or national air quality index value recorded during sampling, if available.

barometric_pressure_hpa.descr: Atmospheric pressure at sampling time, in hectopascals (hPa).

marker_gene.descr: Targeted marker gene for sequencing; expected value is '18S rRNA'.

forward_primer_sequence.descr: Forward primer nucleotide sequence used for amplification, written 5' to 3'.

reverse_primer_sequence.descr: Reverse primer nucleotide sequence used for amplification, written 5' to 3'.

library_prep_protocol.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used for amplicon generation.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction method or kit used for the air-sample filter/material.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used (e.g., Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq).

sequencing_run_id.descr: Sequencing run identifier or accession associated with the record.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for the sequencing run or merged reads, if applicable.

paired_end_reads.descr: Indicates whether sequencing was performed as paired-end reads.

library_insert_size_bp.descr: Approximate insert size for the amplicon library, in base pairs.

sequence_processing_pipeline.descr: Bioinformatics pipeline used for sequence processing (e.g., QIIME2, DADA2, mothur).

quality_filtering_parameters.descr: Summary of key quality filtering settings used during processing, such as trimming lengths or expected error thresholds.

denoising_method.descr: Method used to infer sequence variants or OTUs (e.g., DADA2, UNOISE, OTU clustering).

chimera_check_method.descr: Method used to identify and remove chimeric sequences.

taxonomy_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic assignment (e.g., SILVA, PR2, UNITE if relevant to eukaryotic taxa).

taxonomic_assignment_method.descr: Algorithm or approach used for taxonomic classification (e.g., naive Bayes, BLAST, classifier).

abundance_unit.descr: Unit used for abundance values in downstream tables or outputs (e.g., read_count, relative_abundance_percent).

read_count_total.descr: Total number of raw reads generated for this sample.

read_count_filtered.descr: Number of reads retained after quality filtering.

read_count_assigned.descr: Number of reads assigned to taxa after processing.

negative_control_flag.descr: Indicates whether this record corresponds to a negative control sample.

pcr_cycle_number.descr: Number of PCR amplification cycles used for library generation.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Temperature at which the sample/filter was stored before DNA extraction, in degrees Celsius (°C).

storage_duration_days.descr: Duration between collection and DNA extraction or sequencing storage, in days.

public_health_context.descr: Optional descriptive field for local exposure context or study relevance to public health (e.g., high-traffic area, near hospital), recorded as factual site context rather than interpretation.
